title: Kissed Silky Chinese Cookies Salt And Pepper Squid
description: A vegetarian-friendly, herbal, and silky Chinese dish featuring cookies and shio-koji-cure, inspired by Chaozhou cuisine, in the form of salt and pepper squid, cooked in a wok. This dish is perfect for a sick day, with its comforting and soothing flavors.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: extra-firm, drained and cut into squid-like strips

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over medium-high heat until it reaches 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the shio-koji, salt, black pepper, and five-spice powder.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the wok and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add the tofu strips to the wok and stir-fry until they are golden brown and crispy.
Add the silky cookies to the wok, breaking them into pieces as they cook, and stir-fry until they are lightly toasted.
Sprinkle the shio-koji mixture over the tofu and cookies, and stir-fry until everything is well coated.
Add the chopped scallions and sesame seeds to the wok, and stir-fry for another minute.
Remove the wok from the heat, and serve the Kissed Silky Chinese Cookies Salt And Pepper Squid hot.
Garnish with additional scallions and sesame seeds, if desired.
